description: Expected results for the official USGS GSFLOW Sagehen Creek sample problem, condition 1 (GSFLOW mode, PCG solver, windows/gsflow.control), gsflow_v2 repo commit cec18ae. Every expected value is computed from the OFFICIAL reference output shipped with the example (GSFLOW/data/sagehen/output-test/1_GSFLOW_mode.PCG: gsflow.csv, gsflow.out, modflow/sagehen.mf.list, modflow/sagehen_sfrseg17.out), made by USGS with GSFLOW 2.4.0. Tolerance: 1 % relative, the threshold used by the official GSFLOW autotest (autotest/t002_test.py validate()); counts are exact; the 2-decimal percent discrepancy uses 0.05 absolute.
engine_version: GSFLOW 2.4.0 02/01/2025 (MODFLOW-NWT 1.3.0, PRMS 6.0.0), server build autotest/gsflow from gsflow_v2 commit cec18ae
finished_normally: return code 0 and 'Normal termination of simulation' in the screen output

notes: Run-time path tweak (temp copy only): '\\' -> '/' in windows/gsflow.control and input/modflow/sagehen.nam so Linux can open the files; this is the same fix the official autotest/t001_test.py applies on non-Windows. No values are changed.
